comparison.objective: Separate a glued phone display using suction and an opening tool, hinge it safely on its cable side, and stow tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool switching, suction placement, adhesive-edge separation, prying, cable-aware opening, and cleanup versus hex-key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, locking, and impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: All specified adhesive freed, display supported on the foam without over-opening or cable damage, tools cleared, and arms returned; numeric force/angle tolerances are missing. Candidate has quantified stop and retention limits.
comparison.reason: Adhesive separation and fragile cable-aware disassembly are unrelated to rigid-body damper tuning and dynamic validation.
